notablePrerequisites:
Triskelion has at least two +1/+1 counters.

description:
Give Triskelion deathtouch.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
